test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work individually in 7(1)/(2) days, 15 days and 30 days, respectively. A and B start working but A quits the job after 3 days. Then C joined B and both did the work till the completion of the work. In how many days will the whole work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a work in 7(1)/(2) days. 

B can complete the work in 15 days.

C can complete the work in 30 days.

After 3 days of working with B, A left the job

C joined and finished the remaining work with B

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × Time taken by them

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM of 7(1)/(2), 15, 30 is 30

Efficiency of A = 30 ÷ 7(1)/(2) = 4 units/day

Efficiency of B = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units/day

Efficiency of C = 30 ÷ 30 = 1 unit/day

Let C and B complete the remaining work in 'm' days.

According to the question,

⇒ (4 + 2) × 3 + (2 + 1) × m = 30

⇒ 6 × 3 + 3m = 30

⇒ 18 + 3m = 30

⇒ 3m = 30 - 18

⇒ 3m = 12

⇒ m = 4

So, C and B complete the remaining work in 4 days.

Total time to complete the work = 3 + 4 = 7 days

**∴ The whole work will be completed in 7 days.**
